subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat can render assistant reply before user prompt and duplicate inbound messages

question: Should the open WebChat ingress PR be ported through the current shared user-turn recorder path as the canonical fix for this issue, or should maintainers close that PR and require a fresh current-main repro first?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses WebChat UI projection, Gateway chat.send durability, and shared transcript persistence; automation should not choose the durable user-turn contract or close the issue while the candidate PR is still open and previously blocked.

options.title: Port and Review PR 80670
options.body: Use the open PR as the candidate fix, but require a current-main port through the shared recorder plus busy same-session proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Require Fresh Repro First
options.body: Keep this issue open with needs-info and close or pause the open PR until someone reproduces the exact combined symptom on current main.

options.title: Close Only After Current-Main Proof
options.body: If maintainers can prove current main already fixes the duplicate inbound and ordering sequence, close this issue as implemented with source, history, and release/main-only provenance.

recommendation.title: Port and Review PR 80670
recommendation.body: Use the open PR as the candidate fix, but require a current-main port through the shared recorder plus busy same-session proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved fix boundary is now centered on shared user-turn transcript persistence and Gateway/runtime fallback coordination.
